newsitem.title: THAILAND: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Dec 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Thai press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh's failure to discuss a cut in military spending during his first official meeting with top military brass yesterday raised questions about his government's much-publicised austerity policy and kept alive an Bt86 billion shopping list for the armed forces. (BANGKOK POST)
-Two more workers were arrested yesterday on charges of illegal assembly to provoke unrest in connection with the arson at Sanyo Universal Electric Company on Tuesday night. (THE NATION)

- Amnuay Viravan, leader of the economic "Dream Team" has told investors the government will proceed with utmost haste to introduce his finance ministry's action plan to revive business sentiment.(BUSINESS POST)

- Boon Rawd Brewery Co Ltd, the manufacturer of Singha beer, plans to spend Bt20 million on its Pathum Thani plant to produce a new draft brew called Fass for marketing in Thailand, executive vice president Santi Bhirom Bhakdi said. (THE NATION)
